name: B. F. Matthias
role: Northern Pacific superintendent of the Missouri division
mentions: It has just been learned that Mr. Matthias, the superintendent of this, the Missouri division, has resigned to take effect in a few days. The cause of his action is unknown, but we will certainly be sorry to see…
B. F. Matthias, formerly superintendent of this division of the N. P. is president of the Charlotte Harbor and Northern Central R. R. with headquarters at Tampa, Florida.
